# #2684: Patch: Block on an incoming friend request asks first, as Block on a friend does
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
On the Play together page, an incoming friend request has three buttons side by side: Accept, Decline and Block. Block acts on the first press: the person is blocked, the request is gone, and unblocking later restores nothing, so a slip next to Accept cuts someone off for good. The same Block button on a friend's row already asks once (“Block Sam? You stop being friends, and neither of you can reach the other.”). Once built, Block on a request asks the same way before it blocks.

## Why
- `apps/web/src/together/FriendRows.tsx:182-223`: a friend row's Block opens an inline question with Block and Keep; the file header (`:6-8`) says Block asks once, and only Remove skips the question because it has Undo (R2119000).
- `apps/web/src/together/FriendRows.tsx:266-270`: a request row's Block calls `onBlock` directly, wired to `blockPlayer` in `apps/web/src/together/TogetherRoute.tsx:287-289`.
- §9.4: a block removes every request between the two, and “unblocking lifts it and restores nothing”, so a mistaken block on a request cannot be taken back by the person who made it.

## Proposal
- Give `RequestRow` the `asking` state and inline alert dialog `FriendRow` has, worded for a request (no “You stop being friends”): “Block {name}? Their request goes, and neither of you can reach the other.”, with Block and Keep; Keep puts the row back as it was.
- One new zh-CN string. No server change.
- Record the decision in the PR: the question is inline, as the friend row's is, not a modal.

## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/together/FriendRows.tsx`; tests in `apps/web/src/together/TogetherRoute.test.tsx` (the friends panel's request rows offer no Block, `FriendsButton.tsx:184-195`, so nothing changes there)
- `apps/web/src/i18n/` (the new string)
- SPEC §9.4, §9.5 (Play together)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A first press on an incoming request's Block sends nothing and shows the question with the sender's name.
- [ ] Block in the question sends one block request; Keep sends nothing and restores Accept, Decline and Block.
- [ ] The friend row's Block behaves as before.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on the touched tests, typecheck and eslint pass.

## Size and risks
Small: about 25 lines in one component, one string, two tests. Client only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Risk: an e2e spec of the safety flows that blocks from a request needs the extra click; grep `e2e/` for `requestBlock`.
